subject: Unfair late fee
body:
We were charged a late fee on our recent rental but this was not a genuine late return. We arrived at the depot at the agreed time and nobody was there to receive the equipment. When we came back the following morning the system had already registered it as late. This was a mix-up on the depot side and we should not be paying for it.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy
